test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The patient remembers his son taking him to the temple.

options.text: The patient remembers he was taken to the temple by his son.
The patient remembers taken to the temple by his son.
The patient remembers himself being taken to the temple by his son.
The patient remembers being taken to the temple by his son.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The patient remembers being taken to the temple by his son**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is **4) The patient remembers being taken to the temple by his son.**
 
• This answer can be inferred from the rules of passive voice :
 
 
• To form the passive voice, we use a form of the verb be with a past participle.
 
• The tense of the verb depends on the tense of the active voice sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in **present simple tense**, so we use **is **or **are **in the **passive voice**, depending on the subject.
 
• The subject is the patient, which is **singular**, so we use **is**.
 
 
 
• The **past participle** of take is taken, so we use **that **after is.
 
• If we want to show the doer of the action, we use **by **followed by the agent. The agent is** his son,** so we use **by his son** at the end.
 
• The other options are incorrect because:
 
 
• **Option 1** changes the tense of the sentence from present simple to past simple. It should use is instead of was.
 
• **Option 2** omits the verb be, which is necessary for the passive voice. It should use is before taken.
 
• **Option 3** adds an unnecessary pronoun himself, which does not agree with the subject the patient. It should omit himself.
 
 

**​Correct Sentence:**__ *The patient remembers being taken to the temple by his son.*
